search.universe_rule: Scanner robot_candidates records with scanner_source_candle_time_ms, pinned Bybit class CRYPTO_LINEAR_PERPETUAL, timeframe 1m or 5m, not already in Gold or previously exact-evaluated (NXPCUSDT 5m excluded); closed 199-bar prefix fetched exact and recorded anchor prices must match
search.acceptance_rule: per stratum (alternation bucket 3 / 4 / 5+ x timeframe 1m / 5m): selected cases whose symbol is not in Gold and not CASHCAT/ENA; order by trend class (PERSISTENT_COMPRESSION, EXPANSION, NO_PERSISTENT_WIDTH_TREND), then exact pair count ascending, then case_id; first case whose symbol is not already accepted; fixed before the exact screen, never tuned toward a calibration conclusion
search.stop: SUCCESS (>=3 new cases covering all 3 buckets); candidate universe also fully exhausted

rejected_near_misses.note: no universe case is rejected at defaults because of alternation alone; every rejection is body-integrity and/or shared-support related

observed_min_alternating_touches_diagnos.scope: diagnostic only: min_alternating_touches LOW=2 / CURRENT=3 / HIGH=4; no sweep, no preset, cap unchanged
